CSFloat is a P2P (peer-to-peer) marketplace. That means when an item is sold on CSFloat, it is traded directly from the seller’s Steam inventory to the buyer’s Steam inventory. This has the advantage that sellers can list their items on multiple marketplaces at the same time, since they don’t need to deposit the skins to a single marketplace.
